notes: Mall-side anchor entrance: 'Dillard's' house serif wordmark (mixed case, curly apostrophe), white lit channel faces (read pale blue-white), dark returns casting a shadow on the wall, on a light-oak wood-grain panel band above the wide open entrance. Traced from the court frame; a palm leaf crosses the D's stem, which was redrawn as a straight stem with a bottom serif (the rest of the letters are as traced; the a/r/d interiors are a little soft). Size estimated from the ~12 m entrance: word ~4.0 m, D ~0.78 m tall (+-15%). The exterior wall signs (dark charcoal flat letters on peach EIFS) are separate signs and not built here.
